answer: Each agent files one slope plot with cedar root class and a safety factor from the public grid, locking a 65-credit bond. The board posts it on a meadow plot with its key and factor, charging a fee rising per filing from one source. An auditor recomputes it from the same grid and checks the canyon runout; mismatch, reuse, or a second filing from one source burns the bond. First costs 46, the kth 46+7(k-1), the 1000th 7039; 1000 fakes pay 3,542,500 plus 65,000 locked. A rented-survey ring fails: rented readings carry the lender key. An honest agent files once, pays 46, then recovers the bond.
